title: The 8 Best Mini Table Saw for Crafts 2026
h1: The 8 Best Mini Table Saw for Crafts 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for mini table saw for crafts 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mini table saw for crafts 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: PROXXON 37070 Table Saw FET
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-inch (150mm) blade, Precision ground table, flat and accurate, Parallel fence with fine adjustment.
strengths: Precision-ground table surface is flatter than most mini saws, essential for accurate thin cuts
Fine-adjustment parallel fence enables repeatable cuts to 0.5mm
Dado set compatible, rare at this scale, useful for scale furniture joinery
German engineering: accuracy and build quality matched to professional model making standards
limitations: High price for a hobby-scale saw
Small motor, not suitable for hardwood thicker than 1/2 inch
features: Precision ground table, flat and accurate
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Dremel MS20-01 Moto-Saw Variable Speed Compact Scroll Saw Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: Attaches to workbench or freehand use, Cuts wood, plastic, metal sheets, Fine blade for detail cuts.
strengths: Two modes: table-mounted for small scrolls, freehand for awkward shapes
Cuts thin wood, plastic, and sheet metal, versatile for mixed craft materials
Fine blade produces detail cuts that a table saw cannot
Dremel brand accessories widely available
limitations: Scroll saw, not a table saw, different cutting motion and application
Not suitable for straight rip cuts through standard lumber
features: Attaches to workbench or freehand use

products.name: HYCHIKA Mini Circular Saw, Compact 3-3/8-inch
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact 3-3/8-inch blade, Scale ruler for guided cuts, 4A pure copper motor.
strengths: Lowest price for a functioning craft-scale cutting tool on this list
Compact handheld body fits into tight craft workspaces
3-3/8-inch blade handles thin craft wood, balsa, and softwood strips
Three included blades cover wood, soft metal, and plastic cuts
limitations: Handheld, not a table saw, no built-in fence for long parallel rip cuts
Motor struggles with anything harder than pine at thicknesses over 1/2 inch
Base plate finish is basic, can snag thin stock without care
features: Includes 3 blades for wood, soft metal, and plastic
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: PROXXON 37160 KGS 80 Chop and Miter Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 3-3/16-inch (80mm) blade, Precision miter angle scale, Adjustable material clamp.
strengths: Smallest accurate chop saw, desktop footprint
Precision angle scale makes repeatable miter cuts in thin molding and strip wood
Material clamp holds small stock steady for crosscuts and angled cuts
PROXXON accuracy at the small scale, reliable for model furniture framing
limitations: 3-3/16-inch blade limits to thin stock only, no hardwood over 3/8 inch
Chop saw, not a rip-cutting table saw, different application than the rest of this list

products.name: WORX WORXSAW WX429L 4-1/2 Inch Compact Circular Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 4-1/2 inch blade, Lightweight: 2.1 lbs, Adjustable bevel: 0-45 degrees.
strengths: Lightest saw on this list, minimal fatigue for detail work
Handheld rather than table-mounted, works on any surface
4.5-inch blade handles most craft lumber thicknesses
45-degree bevel for angled cuts in frame and box work
limitations: Handheld, no fence for parallel cuts, accuracy depends on a straight edge guide
Not a table saw, different application than the rest of this list

products.name: WEN TT0811 11-Amp 8.25-Inch Compact Benchtop Jobsite Table Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 8.25-inch blade, Adjustable rip fence, Miter gauge with angle scale.
strengths: 8.25-inch blade gives more cutting depth than 3–4 inch craft saws
Miter gauge with angle scale handles simple frame and box angle cuts
Folding stand makes it easy to store between craft sessions
Lower price than PROXXON for hobbyists who need moderate precision
limitations: Fence adjustment mechanism requires tightening carefully, can drift if not locked fully
Motor struggles with repetitive cuts in hardwood over 1/2 inch thick

products.name: Genesis GTS10SB 10-Inch 15-Amp Table Saw
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-inch full-size blade, 30-inch rip capacity, 15-amp motor.
strengths: Full 10-inch blade handles craft projects AND lumber for furniture and fixtures
30-inch rip capacity handles plywood and full boards
Lowest price for a functional 10-inch table saw
Good choice if crafts are one of several woodworking uses
limitations: Full-size saw, less suitable for tiny scale model making than PROXXON

products.name: DEWALT 15 Amp 8-1/4 Inch Compact Portable Jobsite Table Saw DWE7485
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-1/4 inch blade, Rack and pinion fence, 24.5-inch rip capacity.
strengths: Rack and pinion fence is the most accurate fence on any compact saw
8.25-inch blade handles both craft work and full-scale furniture projects
Compact enough for small shops but powerful enough for real woodworking
DEWALT reliability and service network
limitations: Larger and more powerful than pure craft-scale saws, overkill for balsa and model making
Higher price than basic craft saws

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
